- `approval-workflow-service.ts`'s `decideApprovalStep()`
- `erp-payment-entries-service.ts`'s `canDecidePaymentEntry()`/`decidePaymentEntry()`

**Verified**: full suite (2042 tests) passes, `tsc` clean, and the success-criteria grep command is non-empty.

**Shipped**: [PR #579](https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/579), flagged Tier2 (auth changes) — holds for your sign-off, not requesting autonomous merge. Claim registered in ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml, PROGRESS.md kept current throughout.
